nom: Hero Cosmetics Rescue Balm +Red Correct Post-Blemish Recovery Cream

segments.oily: Several reviewers with oily skin describe the new formula as very greasy and shiny, and note it takes more product to get any redness coverage, with one saying it never fully absorbs.
segments.dry: Some reviewers say the balm keeps skin feeling moisturized all day and works as a light, weightless base rather than a heavy cream.
segments.sensitive: Sensitive-skin reviewers report mixed results: some say it healed blemishes without breakouts or irritation for years, but others report new breakouts, hives, or that it does not suit acne-sensitive skin (one names shea butter, spirulina and beeswax as comedogenic triggers for her).
segments.mature: One reviewer in her 70s used the old formula for years as a primer/foundation for facial redness and considers the reformulation a loss for her routine.

concerns.redness: The large majority of reviewers bought this specifically for rosacea, perioral dermatitis, malar rash or general facial redness, and many long-term users say the old formula reliably neutralized or covered redness; with the new formula, most report it barely covers or reduces redness at all, though a minority of new/positive reviews say the current formula still corrects their redness and breakouts well.
concerns.spots: Reviewers describe using it as a color-correcting spot treatment on red pimples and acne scars; several say the old formula covered spots effectively while multiple say the new formula leaves spots looking more red, orange, or barely covered.
concerns.blemishes: Long-time acne-prone users say the old formula soothed and color-corrected blemishes without causing new breakouts; with the new formula, opinions split — some say it still does not break them out, while a few report increased breakouts or find it unsuitable due to comedogenic ingredients.
concerns.oiliness: Multiple reviewers, especially those with oily skin, say the new formula feels notably oilier, greasier and shinier on the face than the previous version, with one noting it made her skin shinier even though it eventually dried down with minimal application.

aspects.libelle: New formula greasy or sticky feel
New formula turns orange or yellow
Poor shade match for very fair or pale skin

extraits.texte: I have used this ever day for probably about 4 or so years. I have acne prone skin. The old formula soothed my blemishes while also adding a little bit of coverage and color correcting the redness. The result was a nice moisturized glow. This new formula is completely different and I hate it :-(. It does not color correct my redness, and offers no blemish coverage either. It's almost like there is less encapsulated pigments in this formula. To make it worse, this new formula makes my already oily skin SO shiny. I was a die hard fan for so long and now I can't use this product anymore since it does absolutely nothing for my skin.

I have absolutely loved this product for years! It was one of the only products that gave great coverage for acne scars without making my sensitive skin breakout. However, this new formula is greasy, barely color corrects, and is incredibly thin. Bring back the old formula!!

I'm so sad. The new formula is absolute garbage. I have rosacea and the old formula was smooth, provided good coverage with zero effort… I have never been devastated about a beauty product changing before. I'm a very lazy, low maintenance skin care kinda gal, and this truly was my holy grail.
I loved this so much, until it broke me out in hives. DO NOT get this if you have sensitive skin.

If you have acne problems, use the "acne-safe" app. My loves, it is the onlyyyy thing that has saved me. I realized after using this app that this product was causing me to have acne, even though it has "clean ingredients". Please remove or find acne safe replacements for: Butyrospermum Parkii Shea Butter, Spirulina, & Beeswax. These ingredients are why I can no longer use this product. I found it to be amazing otherwise- the way it adjusted to my skin tone was especially wonderful. Oh- I guess I also didnt like how shiny it would make my face. It would eventually dry if I used a very small amount, but would typically make my skin very shiny (& I do not like to use powder bc i have not found one that's non-pore clogging). I could look past this issue however if the product was non-comedogenic.

I have rosacea and this is a godsend. This blends into the skin so seamlessly. Sometimes color correctors will make my skin look dry or the pigment will sit in my huge pores and I hate that. Perfect to spot treat just my cheeks. I like that this is skin care rather than makeup, because I have acne prone skin so I try my best to keep my skin care minimal. 10/10 I recommend

I used this product as my base daily for years. It corrected redness and evened skintone without looking heavy or causing breakouts. It was truly my holy grail cc cream. The new formula is a disappointment. It doesnt dry well, coverage is poor so you have to use twice as much product to get the same redness reduction. While it doesn't break me out, it leaves my face feeling significantly more oily than the old formula did. Hero lost a loyal customer with this formulation change.
